description: Runtime-owned native extension composition and engine-hook contract for FOnline embedding projects.

scope.support_note: Source-compatible use is documented for a pinned engine revision; independently built binary compatibility is not promised.
included: role-scoped project C++ source registration through AddEngineSources
metadata/codegen participation of registered project sources
optional EngineHook declarations, signatures, owning roles, call sites, and generated fallback behavior
native binding and namespace rules required by generated script exports
excluded: project-local extension implementations, dependencies, settings, persistence, and release policy
third-party SDK ABI and project-specific native library packaging
client host/runtime updater ABI and compatibility across independently built engine revisions
native scripting backend internals controlled by FO_NATIVE_SCRIPTING

roles.name: COMMON
roles.description: Code shared by every enabled engine role; use only for genuinely common dependencies and hooks.

roles.name: SERVER
roles.description: Authoritative server-only code and script exports.

roles.name: CLIENT
roles.description: Client runtime code; server controller paths, Mapper, both focused viewers, BakerLib, and ASCompiler link ClientLib, while only client and mapper are script export targets.

roles.name: MAPPER
roles.description: Mapper-only native tooling and mapper script exports.

roles.name: BAKER
roles.description: Resource-baker extensions shared by Baker, Mapper, both focused viewers, and ASCompiler; BAKER is not a script export target.

roles.name: TESTS
roles.description: Project-native Catch2 translation units compiled directly into enabled unit-test and coverage executables; TESTS has no runtime or script-export consumer.

hooks.name: ApplicationInitHook
hooks.default_behavior: No-op before application runtime initialization continues.
hooks.description: Inspect or adjust application startup settings after platform initialization.

hooks.name: ApplicationShutdownHook
hooks.description: Release project-owned process services during application shutdown.

hooks.name: ServerInitHook
hooks.description: Initialize project-owned server services and engine user data.

hooks.name: ClientInitHook
hooks.description: Initialize project-owned client services and engine user data.

hooks.name: ClientStartupSettingsHook
hooks.signature: void ClientStartupSettingsHook(GlobalSettings& settings, int32_t client_index, bool embedded)
hooks.default_behavior: No-op before standalone or embedded client startup.
hooks.description: Adjust per-client startup settings, including embedded multi-client instances.

hooks.signature: void SetupBakersHook(const_span<string> requested, vector<unique_ptr<BaseBaker>>& bakers, shared_ptr<BakingContext> context)
hooks.stub_definition: void SetupBakersHook(span<const string>, vector<unique_ptr<BaseBaker>>&, shared_ptr<BakingContext>) { /* Stub */ }

hooks.description: Apply project visibility policy between an observer critter and map item.

binding_rules.name: Registration order
binding_rules.requirement: Call AddEngineSources after AddThirdPartyLibraries and before the RegisterEngineSources stage entrypoint.
binding_rules.rationale: Project files must enter role source lists and FO_SOURCE_META_FILES before codegen and core libraries are configured.

binding_rules.name: Engine namespace
binding_rules.requirement: Declare metadata exports inside FO_BEGIN_NAMESPACE/FO_END_NAMESPACE and define them with FO_NAMESPACE.
binding_rules.rationale: The same source must compile with the configured engine namespace enabled or disabled.

binding_rules.name: Script export frontier
binding_rules.requirement: Use FO_SCRIPT_API with a supported ///@ metadata tag; do not add stack-trace entry macros to exported bodies.
binding_rules.rationale: Codegen parses the declaration and emits the native/script registration boundary.

binding_rules.name: Pointer contract
binding_rules.requirement: Use ptr<T>/nptr<T> for engine handle borrows and the engine owning-pointer vocabulary for ownership.
binding_rules.rationale: Codegen rejects raw handle pointers and nullability must agree across native and script declarations.

binding_rules.name: Compatibility
binding_rules.requirement: Rebuild and rebake every project-side native metadata change against the pinned engine revision.
binding_rules.rationale: Registered metadata and most hook presence feed generated compatibility state; binary compatibility across independent revisions is not promised.

binding_rules.name: Dependencies
binding_rules.requirement: Declare project libraries, include paths, compile definitions, platform guards, and package payloads in the embedding project.
binding_rules.rationale: AddEngineSources owns source routing only; project dependency and distribution policy is not inferred by the engine.
